svg.title: Great Hall — Banner nave
svg.desc: The procession floor faces a raised dais. A pair of side galleries reach the Archive and sealed tower without forcing visitors across the king’s audience. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: The procession floor faces a raised dais. A pair of side galleries reach the Archive and
sealed tower without forcing visitors across the king’s audience.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Treasury and Archive · P2 Warden Barracks · P3 The King's Room · P4 Tower Base
